guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: The company is raising its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue to be between $17,350 million and $17,500 million, for Adjusted EBITDA to be between $4,025 million and $4,055 million and for Adjusted Diluted Earnings per Share to be between $12.90 and $13.00.

This revenue guidance now anticipates 250 basis points of contribution from acquisitions, including acquisitions the company expects to complete by the end of the year, and approximately 20 basis points of tailwind from foreign exchange.
All financial guidance assumes foreign currency exchange rates as of October 26, 2026 remain in effect for the forecast period.
